FOURTH EDITION · LEIDEN UNIVERSITY

Dutch Clinical

DCNLP 2027

The fourth Dutch Clinical NLP Workshop will take place on Friday 5 February 2027 at the Academiegebouw in Leiden. Join researchers and healthcare professionals to discuss recent work on natural language processing in healthcare.

ABOUT THE WORKSHOP

Connecting clinical practice
and language technology.

Join us in Leiden for a day of research, discussion and collaboration around clinical NLP. The workshop offers a meeting place for people working with clinical language across academia, healthcare and industry.

We will share the programme, submission guidelines and practical details here as they become available.
